parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of `sphinx-quickstart` not exiting when pressing Enter, but introduces a new function `is_path_or_empty` which may not be necessary or clear in its purpose.

issues.description: The introduction of the `is_path_or_empty` function may reduce maintainability as it introduces additional complexity without clear justification.
